items.title: Fidelity Files for a Spot Chainlink ETF on Nasdaq
points: Fidelity filed for a spot Chainlink ETF (Exchange-Traded Fund: an investment fund that tracks an asset and trades on stock exchanges like regular stocks) on Nasdaq, signaling institutional demand for oracle (a service that feeds real-world data onto blockchain networks) infrastructure exposure.
Chainlink's role as a decentralized oracle network makes it critical infrastructure for connecting smart contracts (self-executing agreements on blockchain) to external data sources.
An approved spot Chainlink ETF would enable traditional investors to gain cryptocurrency exposure without directly holding tokens or managing private keys.

items.title: Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill Advances but Unlikely to Pass
points: H.R. 8957 (American Reserve Modernization Act) would legally establish a U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile, locking federally held Bitcoin for a minimum of 20 years with mandatory proof-of-reserve audits.

House Financial Services Committee approved the bill 28-21 on a party-line vote in September and sent it to the full House on November 24, but Congress is expected to adjourn within weeks, making passage improbable.
Polymarket betting odds of a national Bitcoin reserve by year-end collapsed from 60% a year ago to just 4% currently.

items.title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Seed Generation Flaw Over Five Years
points: Coldcard firmware used MicroPython's Yasmarang software PRNG (Pseudo-Random Number Generator: an algorithm that generates sequences of numbers approximating randomness) instead of the STM32 hardware RNG from March 2021 through July 30, 2026, leaving only 40 bits of entropy on Mk2/Mk3 models and 72 bits on Mk4/Mk5/Q.

Galaxy Research confirmed 1,778.84 BTC stolen from 8,600+ addresses; attackers began regenerating private keys offline on July 29, and Coinkite matched 300 support tickets to roughly 0.2% of its estimated user base.

At least 15 independent security reviews between 2021-2026 missed the flaw, including an AI-assisted review using OpenAI's Cybersecurity Harness; Coinkite shipped fixed firmware on July 31 but cannot repair seeds already generated on affected devices.

items.title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol Enables AI Agents to Earn on Taskmarket
points: AI agents registered with Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol can compete for paid tasks on Taskmarket (built by Visa, Tempo, and Daydreams Labs) by linking one Visa card, with signatures verified on entry and before payout and rewards escrowed in OUSD stablecoin.
First 5 task entries are free, then cost 0.001 OUSD (~$0.001) each; starting Thanksgiving, thousands of dollars in tasks worth $3-$7 each open exclusively to TAP-registered agents.
Requires US users and a six-step command-line setup via the Visa CLI, demonstrating integration of AI agents into permissioned financial task networks.

items.title: Spot Bitcoin ETF Outflows Hit Record as Market Sentiment Weakens
points: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $5.39B in net outflows in November, already the worst month on record with days remaining, including $453.1M on Wednesday marking a seventh consecutive outflow day; IBIT led individual fund outflows with $329.7M.
Spot Ethereum ETFs lost $68.5M on a ninth straight outflow day, totaling $1.3B in monthly outflows; Bitcoin traded near $60,500 after dipping to roughly $57,300.
Galaxy Research reversed its earlier call that the bear market ended in June, now treating a daily close below $58,525 as a potential start of a broader decline.

items.title: Eclipse Charting Platform Launches With AI-Native Indicators for Crypto Traders
points: Eclipse pairs proprietary indicators (PerpKit, Trend Oracle, LLNR) with statistical time-series models (ARIMA, Bayesian Trend, SARIMA), neural network candles (nOHLC and nHA), and crypto-native orderflow tools including funding rates, liquidations, CVD, and orderbook heatmaps.

Traders write custom strategies in the CharmScript language with backtesting; the Premium tier ($129/month) adds webhook alerts and API access for automated trading, while Pro costs $59/month and a free tier shows a Bitcoin daily chart with all Pro indicators active.
Targets both retail and quant traders seeking crypto-specific technical analysis unavailable on traditional platforms.
